countryMotifPolicy.flagMotifDecision: Norway's flag uses an official Nordic cross with religious origins, so no literal flag or cross is copied into fashion. Every scene instead uses large complete secular Norwegian architecture, landscape, civilian craft, engineering, or food motifs across at least two outfits.

countryMotifPolicy.minimumCoverage: Every scene renders large complete secular Norway motifs across at least two outfits as full bodice, skirt, hip, or panel fields rather than tiny trim.
countryMotifPolicy.cultureScene: Scene 1181 foregrounds Bergen's Bryggen gables and fish-market heritage with salmon, stockfish, colorful rosemaling craft, heart-shaped Norwegian waffles, brunost slices, and polished serving pieces in an unattended public-safe market display.
countryMotifPolicy.prohibitions: No literal flag, Nordic cross, coat of arms, royal lion, official emblem, sacred symbol, political insignia, copied bunad, copied Sami clothing, badge, or branded product.
